import 'dart:isolate';

int weigh(List<int> parcels) {
  var total = 0;
  for (final parcel in parcels) {
    if (parcel > 10) {
      total += parcel * 2;
    } else {
      total += parcel;
    }
  }
  return total;
}

/// The same, in another isolate: no variable of this one is seen there.
Future<int> weighElsewhere(List<int> parcels) =>
    Isolate.run(() => weigh(parcels));

int surcharge(int weight) => weight > 50 ? weight ~/ 10 : 0;
